skill.name: internal-comms
skill.description: Draft internal communications using provided guidelines for 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.
skill.summary: Create concise, structured internal communications for teams, leaders, and company-wide audiences.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Important updates can become inconsistent or difficult to scan. This skill structures concise internal messages for teams, leaders, and company-wide audiences.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 3P updates with Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Creates company newsletters organized by topic and company-wide relevance.
Produces employee FAQs with concise questions, sourced answers, and uncertainty notes.
Adapts general communications to audience, purpose, tone, and format.
Supports status, leadership, project, and incident update requests.
Prioritizes concise, active, data-driven writing with relevant links.
limitations: Does not independently access Slack, email, calendars, or documents without connected tools and permission.
Cannot verify facts, metrics, links, or official positions unless users provide authoritative sources.
Provides writing guidance, not approval for sensitive, legal, human resources, or executive communications.
Uses broad templates that may require adaptation to each company style.

use_cases.title: Publish a Weekly Team Update
use_cases.description: Convert team accomplishments, priorities, and blockers into a concise 3P update for leaders and partner teams.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Company Newsletter
use_cases.description: Organize verified announcements and milestones into themed, scannable bullets for broad employee distribution.

use_cases.title: Clarify Program Changes
use_cases.description: Turn official decisions and recurring employee questions into concise FAQs with uncertainty clearly identified.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a General Announcement
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a concise internal announcement about [topic] for [audience]. Use a [tone] tone and put the most important information first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a basic message from a defined topic, audience, and tone.

prompt_templates.title: Create a 3P Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 3P update for [team] covering [dates]. Use these facts: [facts]. Keep each section to three sentences or fewer.
prompt_templates.scenario: Structure a weekly team update for leadership and partner teams.

prompt_templates.title: Build Employee FAQs
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these employee questions and official sources into FAQs: [material]. Mark uncertain answers and identify items needing executive confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resolve recurring questions while preserving source authority and uncertainty.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize a Company Newsletter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company newsletter from [source summaries]. Group 20 to 25 concise bullets by theme, prioritize broad impact, and retain authoritative links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine multiple verified sources into a company-wide newsletter.

output_examples.input: Team Atlas shipped search filters, plans mobile testing, and needs legal approval. Cover July 14 through July 20.
output_examples.output:
Team Atlas (July 14-20)
Progress: Shipped search filters.
Plans: Complete mobile testing.
Problems: Legal approval remains pending.

output_examples.input: Employees ask whether office days changed. The official policy says schedules remain team-specific.
output_examples.output:
Question: Have required office days changed?
Answer: No company-wide change was announced. Team-specific schedules remain in effect.

output_examples.input: Prepare newsletter bullets from an approved product launch, a new finance leader, and published quarterly goals.
output_examples.output:
Company Announcements
- We launched the approved product release.
- Our new finance leader has started.
- Quarterly goals are now published.

best_practices: Provide the audience, date range, purpose, tone, and required format before drafting.
Supply verified facts, metrics, links, and official statements for accurate content.
Review sensitive details, permissions, and organizational approvals before distribution.
anti_patterns: Do not invent achievements, metrics, answers, links, or executive positions.
Do not include confidential source material beyond what the audience may access.
Do not use a company-wide format for narrow team details.

faq.question: Which communication formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, incident reports, and general announcements.

faq.question: Can it gather information from company systems?
faq.answer: It can use connected tools when available and permitted. Otherwise, provide source material directly.

faq.question: Will it verify company facts?
faq.answer: No. Provide authoritative documents, messages, metrics, and links, then review every factual claim before distribution.

faq.question: How concise are 3P updates?
faq.answer: Each Progress, Plans, and Problems section uses one to three sentences and targets a 30 to 60 second reading time.

faq.question: Can it match our company style?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide tone, formatting requirements, examples, and audience expectations.

faq.question: How should sensitive communications be handled?
faq.answer: Limit source access, remove unnecessary confidential details, and obtain required legal, executive, or human resources approval.
